newsitem.title: UK: Ramco rises on project, public offer plans.
newsitem.headline: Ramco rises on project, public offer plans.

text.p: Shares in Ramco Energy Plc soared to an all-time high on Friday morning on news that the energy services and exploration company planned to make an international public offering and expand energy exploration.
"The capital is to be raised for an expansion plan. These are both good news for the share price," one market-maker said.
At 1000 GMT, Ramco shares were up 122-1/2 pence at 10.15 stg.

Earlier on Friday, the company said it planned to make an international public offering of about 8.5 million shares to support a listing on the U.S. exchange, NASDAQ. The company expects to raise around $115 million.

The small British company, which is already listed on the Alternative Investment Market of the London Stock Exchange, also said it had agreed to set up a joint oil and gas exploration venture with the Georgian government.
Ramco said the venture would explore and develop a block with oil and gas potential in the former Soviet republic's Alazani valley and Greater Caucasus foothills.
Ramco's exploration activities to date have been concentrated in the neighbouring republic of Azerbaijan.
